No auth. A shared-session or collab guest link has no session, yet its page still draws surfaces a plugin provides (a remote desktop stream). Returns only enabled plugins whose manifest sets contributes.guest, with the fields the browser loader needs and nothing operational, plus the ?view= names each serves to guests (contributes.guestViews).
